install: set -euo pipefail; export THEOS="${THEOS:-/tmp/theos}"; export PATH="$THEOS/bin:$PATH"; if [ ! -d "$THEOS/makefiles" ]; then git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/theos/theos.git "$THEOS"; fi; if [ ! -f "$THEOS/vendor/dm.pl/dm.pl" ]; then (cd "$THEOS" && ./bin/update-theos); fi; if [ ! -x "$THEOS/toolchain/linux/iphone/bin/clang" ]; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential fakeroot dpkg-dev rsync curl perl zip git libxml2 libtinfo6; curl -sL https://github.com/L1ghtmann/llvm-project/releases/latest/download/iOSToolchain-x86_64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C "$THEOS/toolchain/"; fi; if [ ! -d "$THEOS/sdks/iPhoneOS16.5.sdk" ]; then bash "$THEOS/bin/install-sdk" iPhoneOS16.5; fi; pip install -q pillow numpy
